An independent analysis of Great American Beer Festival competition results.
It is built from public data by a static pipeline in this repository and published with GitHub Pages. Charts are drawn with Apache ECharts; each one has a table view and saves as a PNG.
complete: the official winners list was ingested.
partial: only seed rows from secondary sources are present.
draft: rows transcribed from the awards ceremony, pending the official list.
pending: the competition ran or is scheduled but no results are loaded.

Results: the Brewers Association's official GABF winners lists (PDF), parsed by scripts/parse-winners.mjs. Category names and total entrants come from the same lists. Before the PDF is posted, the ceremony transcript importer drafts rows from the live stream captions.
Brewery locations, coordinates, type, and websites: Open Brewery DB (free, open) plus curated overrides.
The repository also configures the unofficial Open Brewery DB MCP server for agent lookups.

Style definitions and ABV, IBU, and SRM ranges: Brewers Association Beer Style Guidelines, imported with scripts/import-style-guidelines.mjs. Special categories are flagged by rule and per category in data/reference/categories.csv.
Ownership, investors, and distributors: curated from public announcements (company releases, Brewbound, trade press, state license lookups). Each row carries a verified flag.

Demographics and denominators: Census Bureau annual population estimates (July 1, Vintage 2020 for 2018 and 2019, Vintage 2025 for 2020 to 2025; 2026 medals use 2025), BEA real GDP in chained 2017 dollars and nominal GDP by state (SAGDP1) and county (CAGDP1)

ACS 2024 one year estimates (age, race and Hispanic origin, education, median household income, poverty), 2020 Census urban share, NCES PIAAC modeled literacy estimates (pooled 2012, 2014, and 2017), and NCHS state life expectancy for 2022. Census regions and divisions come from data/reference/states.csv.

Federal Reserve districts: the Board of Governors' district descriptions and the Reserve Banks' county lists (St. Louis, Minneapolis, Dallas, Philadelphia), with counts checked against Cleveland Fed and FRASER figures.

Medals in split states are assigned by the medal city's county from the Census place and county subdivision files. West Virginia has no published county list and is assigned whole to the Richmond district as an approximation. District GDP for split states is apportioned by county GDP shares (E).
Competition totals: Brewers Association annual releases and same day coverage of each announcement.
Production, volume, revenue, and margin figures marked (E) are estimates.

Volume order of preference: a reported figure, then a Brewery of the Year bracket (midpoint), then a curated estimate in data/reference/production.csv or a brewery profile, then a heuristic by brewery type and location count.
Conversions use the US beer barrel (31 gallons): 13.78 cases of 24 twelve ounce containers, 248 sixteen ounce cans or pints, 330.7 twelve ounce cans.

Revenue uses Brewers Association benchmark revenue per barrel by channel (direct to consumer 1,276 USD, distributed 602 USD, blended by brewery type) plus food revenue per kitchen location. ARR is the annual revenue run rate.
Gross margin and EBITDA margin are point estimates by brewery type with channel ranges (taproom 8 to 24 percent, self distribution 5 to 11 percent, distributor 2 to 6 percent).
Parameters and their sources live in data/reference/estimation-parameters.json.

A brewery's yearly trend distinguishes: medaled, no medal recorded, did not exist yet (year before its founding), closed, results not yet published, year only partially loaded, and no results loaded. A partially loaded year is labelled as such rather than counted as a miss.

A GitHub Pages site is public even when its repository is private (Pages for a private repository needs a paid plan, and access control needs GitHub Enterprise Cloud).
